{{recipesummary|category=Cake recipes|servings=8|time=1 hour|difficulty=1}}
{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|American cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Vegetarian cuisine|Vegetarian Cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Bread|Bread]] | [[Cookbook:Dessert|Dessert]]

This is a fast and easy cake to make.

==Ingredients==
* 1 can (20 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]]) crushed [[Cookbook:Pineapple|pineapple]] with juice, undrained
* 1 can (21 ounces) [[Cookbook:Cherry|cherry]] pie filling
* 1 package yellow [[Cookbook:Cake Mix|cake mix]]
* ½ cup [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] [[Cookbook:Chop|chopped]] [[Cookbook:Pecan|pecans]]

== Procedure ==

=== Dutch oven method ===
# Preheat [[Cookbook:Dutch Oven|Dutch oven]] in a 350°F [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]]. Grease the Dutch oven.
# Dump in pineapple with juice and spread evenly.
# Dump in pie filling and spread evenly over the pineapple.
# Sprinkle cake mix evenly over cherry layer.
# Dot with butter.
# [[Cookbook:Bake|Bake]] about 50 minutes at 350°F.
# Sprinkle chopped pecans on top.

=== Pan method ===
# Preheat oven to [[Cookbook:Oven_temperatures|350°F]].
# Grease 13x9-inch [[Cookbook:Cake Pan|cake pan]].
# Proceed as in the Dutch oven method above, starting with step #2.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==
* You can bake this without a conventional oven by using the Dutch oven method. After filling the Dutch oven, cover it and place it on a bed of coals. Place additional coals on top. Use very few coals on the bottom and more on top.
* Put a glass full of water in the middle of the Dutch Oven before baking to help it bake evenly, from inside and out.
* Use any pie filling you want.
* Serve warm or room temperature.
